cohort: 200 pregnant individuals with singleton pregnancies and fetal growth restriction.
finding: Adverse perinatal outcomes were associated with changes in the pulsatility index of the uterine artery, umbilical artery, and middle cerebral artery, with worse outcomes observed in those with deranged cerebroplacental ratio.
mod_finding: The rate of Cesarean section was higher in groups with abnormal velocimetry and CPR (12%, 32%, 74%, and 92% in groups I, II, III, and IV, respectively).
gest_age: 38.1+/-2.3, 37.3+/-3.2, 36+/-3.6 and 33.1+/-3.1 weeks in groups I, II, III, and IV, respectively
birth_weight: 2432+/-423, 2209+/-329, 2100+/-223 and 1329+/-403 grams in Groups-I, II, III, and IV, respectively
